title: OpenMinutes transcript frontmatter, version 1
description: The YAML frontmatter of an OpenMinutes transcript.md, as JSON. The contract is FILE-FORMAT.md; this schema describes it for checkers and other writers. Load the YAML with a YAML 1.2 core schema loader so recorded stays a string. Unknown keys are allowed, because readers must ignore them.

openminutes.description: Format major version. This schema describes version 1; a reader that meets a higher value reads the keys it knows and says the file is in a newer format.

spec.description: URL of FILE-FORMAT.md, so a reader that has never seen the format can fetch the contract.

id.description: Stable identifier minted once by the writer and never changed. Opaque: compare it, do not parse it. OpenMinutes writes a lowercase UUID. Added 2026-09-30.

recorded.description: Start of recording, ISO 8601 with the device's local UTC offset, e.g. 2026-06-09T14:09:00-05:00.

generator.description: Writing app and version, e.g. OpenMinutes 1.0 (build 42).

ref.description: Opaque value supplied by whoever asked for the recording, written back exactly as received. Meaningful only to the tool that supplied it. Added 2026-09-30.

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the transcript body, e.g. en-US. Absent on audio-only files. The pattern is RFC 5646's Language-Tag grammar, case-insensitive: it checks that a tag is well-formed, not that its subtags are registered.

speakers.description: Speaker ID to display name. Present only when speaker labels were produced.

audio.description: Filename of the sibling audio file in the same folder. Present only when the user keeps audio.
